follow_up_questions.title: Rest pain or worsening pattern
follow_up_questions.question: Have you had chest pain at rest or at night, or is it coming on with less walking, more often or lasting longer than before?
follow_up_questions.why: Rest or crescendo pain separates unstable from stable angina and decides whether same-day evaluation is needed.

follow_up_questions.title: Symptoms during exertional episodes
follow_up_questions.question: When the pressure comes on while walking, do you also get short of breath, sweaty, nauseous, lightheaded or faint?
follow_up_questions.why: Associated symptoms were only asked about for the present moment, not during the episodes.

follow_up_questions.title: Allergies to sulfa or aspirin
follow_up_questions.question: Do you have any allergy to sulfa drugs or aspirin, or any history of stomach ulcers or bleeding?
follow_up_questions.why: Hydrochlorothiazide and aspirin were started without checking allergies or bleeding risk.

follow_up_questions.title: Smoking and cholesterol history
follow_up_questions.question: Do you smoke or have you ever smoked, and has your cholesterol been checked or treated?
follow_up_questions.why: These cardiac risk factors shape the angina work-up and preventive therapy but were not discussed.
